title: Offences committed by a company
chapter: Chapter VIII — Offences, Penalties, and Trial
text: Offences committed by a company.— When an offence under this Act is committed by a company, and if its director, executive, manager, secretary or any personnel or employee has a direct involvement with the offence, that person shall be deemed to have committed the offence, unless the person establishes that the offence was committed without their knowledge and that he exercised due diligence to prevent it.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
